name: labs/pymodaq__pymodaq_plugins_newport
title: Newport SMC100 single-axis motion controller
intro: Newport SMC100 single-axis motion controller, adapted from pymodaq/pymodaq_plugins_newport. It reads `identity`, `position`, `is_moving`, `speed` and 1 more; runs `move_abs`, `move_rel`, `home` and `stop_motion`. `move_abs`: command an absolute move with PA; the controller reports completion through is_moving. A hardware driver: the market serves its fake backend, so no instrument is needed.
